summary: Rwanda gives every nationality a visa on arrival: citizens of all African Union, Commonwealth and Francophonie states get it free of charge for a visit of 30 days, nationals of the countries on a separate list — among them Ghana, Senegal, Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines and Qatar — get a 90-day visa free of charge, East African Community citizens get a free pass for six months, and every other nationality receives a 30-day visa on arrival (or applies online via Irembo).

notes: Canada's travel advice says non-biodegradable bags are prohibited in Rwanda and are confiscated if you arrive with them at Kigali airport. The UK Foreign Office adds that vapes and e-cigarettes are banned, including for personal use.

payments.text: Canada's travel advice describes Rwanda as a cash-based economy in which electronic payments are becoming more available: credit cards are usually accepted at most hotels and lodges and at most businesses, restaurants and shops in Kigali, but expect to pay other expenses in cash. Some ATMs may not accept foreign cards, and most shops will not accept or exchange US dollar notes printed before 2006.

safety.text: The UK government advises against all but essential travel to the parts of Rusizi District within 10 km of the border with the DRC, including the Rwandan islands in Lake Kivu and Kamembe Airport. It says crime levels are relatively low, though burglary, theft, bag-snatching and mugging occur in Kigali; that near the DRC and Burundi borders there is a risk of cross-border attacks; that opening hours at the Gisenyi–Goma and Cyangugu–Bukavu crossings vary; and that Burundi closed its border with Rwanda in January 2024.

tips.text: The UK Foreign Office says plastic bags are banned in Rwanda and will be confiscated if you have them on arrival.
The UK Foreign Office says the last Saturday of each month is Umuganda, a national day of community service, when most normal services close from 7 am to 11 am.

Canada advises a high degree of caution in parts of Rubavu and Rusizi districts near the DRC border because of rebel groups on the Congolese side, and says crossing at the Gisenyi–Goma and Cyangugu–Bukavu border posts is prohibited for most travellers.

Rwanda's immigration directorate says the USD 100 East Africa Tourist Visa covers Rwanda, Kenya and Uganda for 90 days with multiple entries within the three countries. If you get it before travel, your first entry must be into the country through which you applied.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Rwanda?
faq.answer: Every nationality can get a visa on arrival without applying in advance. Citizens of all African Union, Commonwealth and Francophonie member states get it free of charge for a visit of 30 days, nationals of the countries on Rwanda's 90-day list (among them Ghana, Senegal, Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines and Qatar) get a 90-day visa free of charge, East African Community citizens get a free pass for six months, and every other nationality receives a 30-day visa on arrival (USD 50).

faq.question: How does Rwanda's visa on arrival work?
faq.answer: All nationalities are eligible. At Kigali International Airport or any land border you pay USD 50 for a 30-day single-entry tourist visa. You can also apply online through the Irembo portal before departure and pay online or on arrival.

faq.question: What is the East Africa Tourist Visa?
faq.answer: A joint USD 100 visa valid 90 days for multiple entries across Kenya, Rwanda and Uganda. You can get it online (for Rwanda, via the Irembo portal), on arrival or from a Rwandan mission; if you get it before travel, your first entry must be into the country through which you applied.

faq.question: Is Rwanda safe to visit?
faq.answer: The UK government says crime levels are relatively low, though burglary, theft, bag-snatching and mugging occur in Kigali. It advises against all but essential travel to the parts of Rusizi District within 10 km of the DRC border, and warns of a risk of cross-border attacks near the DRC and Burundi borders.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever vaccination for Rwanda?
faq.answer: The UK Foreign Office says you need a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

faq.question: Can I extend my stay in Rwanda?
faq.answer: Some visa classes can be extended. Rwanda's Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration says the details are set out in the information for applicants for each visa class; apply before your current stay expires.
